segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the quote for the calibration management rollout and make sure the seat count and dates line up before I send the final order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 42 users total: 31 technicians, 7 supervisors, and 4 people in quality who just need reporting access.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The quote I have is 38 full users and 4 reporting users. Based on what you just said, we should move that to 38 full users? Sorry, 31 techs plus 7 supervisors, and then 4 reporting-only.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Exactly. The supervisors need to approve work orders and review overdue calibrations, so they need full access.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. For pricing, that puts the annual subscription at $46,800, with implementation at $8,500 one-time. That includes the asset import, two admin trainings, and three technician training sessions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what procurement expected. Can you set the contract start for April 1? We want the go-live on May 6 after we finish the gauge inventory.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, April 1 start and May 6 go-live. We’ll schedule the import file review the week of April 15, then training the week of April 29. Does that work for your team?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that should work. We may need one of the technician sessions at 6:30 a.m. for first shift.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. I’ll note one early session. On billing, annual upfront to the headquarters address on the quote, net 30 terms, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. Send it to invoices at our corporate domain, and copy me. Once I have the order form, I can get signature this week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Great. I’ll send the updated order form today with 31 technician users, 7 supervisor users, 4 reporting users, April 1 start, and May 6 go-live.
